meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以按代码结构（而非文本）搜索和重写代码。支持 25 种语言，例如查找特定形状的函数、调用、类，或批量替换代码模式（如将 console.log 换成 logger.info），还能应用 YAML 规则做自动修复。
howto.when: 当用户需要基于代码的结构形态（比如函数签名、调用模式、类定义）进行搜索或替换，而不是匹配字符串内容时触发。

say.text: 把项目中所有的 console.log 替换成 logger.info
say.note: Claude 会先预览再执行替换。

say.text: 找到所有空 catch 块
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出匹配位置。

say.text: 将 require 改成 import 语法
say.note: Claude 会按结构匹配 CommonJS 模块导入。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can search and rewrite code based on syntax structure (not text) across 25 languages. It finds functions, calls, classes, imports by shape, performs codemods like replacing console.log with logger.info, and applies YAML rules for auto-fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs structural code matching or transformation, such as finding every function with a specific parameter or rewriting all occurrences of a pattern, rather than searching by text content.

say_en.text: Replace all console.log with logger.info in the project.
say_en.note: Claude will preview first, then apply.
Claude will search and list matching locations.
